title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Authorization Hold Amount
content:
**Payments clause — the amount of the authorization hold on a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental contract.** The authorization hold is the card deposit of the class for the card on file with the reservation — the class credit card figure on a credit card or the class debit card figure on a debit card, as shown on the class card and deposit schedule — plus the first-day rental fee posted on the contract, rounded to the cent.

The card on file is the deposit card type recorded with the reservation; the first-day rental fee posted is the base rental fee standing on the contract.

## Worked figures (hypothetical Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck contracts; card figures 150.00 credit and 250.00 debit; first-day rental fee posted 29.95)

| Card on file | Card deposit | First-day rental fee posted | Authorization hold |
|---|---|---|---|
| Credit card | 150.00 | 29.95 | 179.95 |
| Debit card | 250.00 | 29.95 | 279.95 |
